description_en: Invoke DescribeIpTraffic to query the service traffic information of a specified IP address
description_zh: 调用DescribeIpTraffic查询指定IP的业务流量信息
kebab_example: aliyun ddoscoo describe-ip-traffic --source-ip 1.1.1.1 --resource-group-id xxx --start-time 1536734112 --interval 60 --end-time 1536734120 --eip 1.1.1.1 --port 233 --query-protocol http --api-version 2017-12-28 --region cn-hangzhou
name: DescribeIpTraffic

parameters.help_en: The source IP of the request. You do not need to specify this parameter because the system automatically retrieves it
parameters.help_zh: 请求源IP。无需填写，系统自动获取
parameters.name: source_ip

parameters.help_en: The ID of the resource group
parameters.name: resource_group_id

parameters.help_en: The UNIX timestamp (in seconds) that indicates the start time
parameters.name: start_time

parameters.help_en: The sampling interval (in seconds). The value must be a multiple of 60 seconds. Default value: 60 s. The sampling result can be scaled
parameters.help_zh: 采样间隔（秒），必须是60秒的倍数，默认值60s。采样结果可缩放
parameters.name: interval

parameters.help_en: The UNIX timestamp (in seconds) that indicates the end time
parameters.name: end_time

parameters.help_en: The elastic IP address (EIP) to query
parameters.name: eip

parameters.help_en:
The port to query.

If this parameter is not specified, the traffic of all ports under the elastic IP addresses (EIPs) is queried
parameters.help_zh:
要查询的端口。 

若不传入该参数，则查询EIP下所有端口的流量。
parameters.name: port

parameters.help_en:
The protocol type to query.

If this parameter is not specified, the traffic of all protocol types under the elastic IP addresses (EIPs) is queried
parameters.help_zh:
要查询的协议类型。

若不传入该参数，则查询EIP下所有协议类型的流量。
parameters.name: query_protocol
